_note: Lines for Nishiki Hill's events (data/events/triggers_hill.json): the mountain shrine, the view from the lookout (in spring over the cherries, in fall over the maples, in winter under snow), the first climb. Each part ends with next: end.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: A shrine no bigger than a birdhouse, tucked in under the trees. Someone has left a fresh sprig of green in its little vase.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: From up here the whole valley shows: the paddies shining, roofs along the road, and far off, my own field.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Cherry blossom spills down the slope below me, and past it lies the whole valley: the paddies, the roofs, my own field.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: The slope below burns red and gold with maples. Past it, the valley looks small and warm.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: The valley lies white and quiet. Smoke climbs straight up from the chimneys along the road.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Phew, what a climb. Cherries and maples line the path all the way up, and the air smells green.
